```yaml
lines:
  - id: eic.zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero (-0-), the amount used where the instructions say you can't take the credit or to enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    note: "The text gives no EIC-specific zero constant. The declared zero-valued money parameter ss.zero is used."

  - id: eic.step5_line1
    printed: "(Step 5, 1)"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line1z}
    note: "Clergy and church employees enter line 1z (or 1a) less the amount also reported on Schedule SE. Those filers are outside scope (scope.schedule1, and person.se_screen per person), so line 1z is copied unchanged. The refusal sits on eic.h_figured."

  - id: eic.step5_line2
    printed: "(Step 5, 2)"
    label: "Enter the Medicaid waiver payment amounts excluded from income on Schedule 1, line 8s, unless you choose to include these amounts in earned income, in which case enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.zero}
    refuses: [s1.line8_other, scope.other_income]

  - id: eic.step5_line3
    printed: "(Step 5, 3)"
    label: "Subtract line 2 from line 1"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.step5_line1, take: eic.step5_line2}

  - id: eic.step5_line4
    printed: "(Step 5, 4)"
    label: "Enter all of your nontaxable combat pay if you elect to include it in earned income"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.zero}
    refuses: [s8812.combat_pay]

  - id: eic.earned_income
    printed: "(Step 5, 5)"
    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}

  - id: eic.h_sc_people
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of persons on the return with a Schedule C business (self-employed)"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.one, where: {op: test, eq: [person.has_sc, {const: true}]}}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_used
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 2: Were you self-employed at any time in 2025? (Yes: use Worksheet B)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_sc_people, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    note: "Clergy, church employees and statutory employees are refused by scope.schedule1. Self-employment is therefore read as having a Schedule C."

  - id: eic.h_wsa_used
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A applies (answered No to Step 5, question 2)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_used, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1e
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 1e: Schedule SE line 3 plus lines 4b and 5a, minus line 13 (filers of Schedule SE)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.eic_part1, where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}}
    note: "Assumes the catalog field person.eic_part1 is this person's Worksheet B Part 1 result (1c minus 1d). The catalog does not state its computation."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_2c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 2c: net profit or (loss) from Schedule C, line 31 (self-employed not required to file Schedule SE)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.sc_total, where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: false}]}}
    note: "Farm and Schedule K-1 amounts (line 2a and part of 2b) are outside scope. Those filers are screened by person.se_screen and scope.schedule1."

  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_wsb_1e, eic.h_wsb_2c, eic.earned_income]}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsb_used
    note: "Line 3 (statutory employee Schedule C income) is out of scope (scope.schedule1) and contributes nothing. Line 4a is the Step 5 earned income."

  - id: eic.h_qc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of children who meet the conditions to be your qualifying child for the EIC"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: dependent, field: dependent.one, where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}}

  - id: eic.h_has_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, question 1: Do you have at least one child who meets the conditions to be your qualifying child for the EIC?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}

  - id: eic.h_ssn_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: dependent, field: dependent.one, where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn_child, {const: true}]}}
    note: "Assumes dependent.eic_ssn_child marks an EIC qualifying child who has a valid SSN."

  - id: eic.h_mfj
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filing status is married filing jointly"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}

  - id: eic.h_lim0o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$19,104 (no children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim0j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$26,214 if married filing jointly (no children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim1o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$50,434 (1 child with a valid SSN)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim1j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$57,554 if married filing jointly (1 child with a valid SSN)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim2o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$57,310 (2 children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim2j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$64,430 if married filing jointly (2 children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim3o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$61,555 (3 or more children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim3j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$68,675 if married filing jointly (3 or more children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.joint}

  - id: eic.h_limit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit for your number of children with valid SSNs and filing status (Step 1, question 1; Step 5, question 3; Worksheet B, line 5)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim0o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim0j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim1o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim1j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim2o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim2j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim3o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim3j

  - id: eic.h_th0o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$10,620 (no qualifying children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.other}
  - id: eic.h_th0j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$17,730 if married filing jointly (no qualifying children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.joint}
  - id: eic.h_th1o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$23,350 (1 or more qualifying children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.other}
  - id: eic.h_th1j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$30,470 if married filing jointly (1 or more qualifying children with valid SSNs)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.joint}

  - id: eic.h_ws_threshold
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 5 / Worksheet B line 10 threshold for your number of children with valid SSNs and filing status"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th0o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th0j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th1o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th1j

  - id: eic.h_wsb_in_range
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B: line 4b is more than zero and less than the limit for your children and filing status (line 5 Yes)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_show_wsb6
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B Part 5 is completed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_used, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_in_range, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: eic.zero}
    shown_when: eic.h_show_wsb6
    note: "Line 6 is reached only when line 4b is more than zero (otherwise STOP). Line 4b floored at zero equals line 4b wherever the line is shown."

    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.earned_income}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsa_used

  - id: eic.h_a2_0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a2_1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a2_2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a2_3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here"
    type: NonNegDollars
    shown_when: eic.h_wsa_used
    note: "The table starts at $1. An amount under $1 is read as a credit of zero. An amount at or above the limit for the column is 'can't take the credit' (table footnotes), entered as zero."
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
          then: eic.zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}]}
          then: eic.zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2_0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2_1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2_2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2_3

  - id: eic.h_show_a3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A continues past line 2 (line 2 is not zero)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsa_used, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, ne: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}

    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"

    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a5_1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a5_2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a5_3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.h_show5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 5 is completed (line 4 No and line 3 not less than the threshold)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_show_a3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}

  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "If line 3 is not less than $10,620 ($17,730 if married filing jointly) with no qualifying children who have valid SSNs, or $23,350 ($30,470 if married filing jointly) with 1 or more: look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Enter the credit here"
    type: NonNegDollars
    shown_when: eic.h_show5
    note: "Line 5 is left blank (zero here) when line 3 is under the threshold. An amount on line 3 at or above the column's limit is 'can't take the credit' in the table, read as zero. The same value also serves as Worksheet B line 10, which looks up the same line 11b amount."
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}
          then: eic.zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_limit]}]}
          then: eic.zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a5_0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a5_1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a5_2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a5_3

  - id: eic.h_a6_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Smaller of lines 5 and 2"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}

  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    shown_when: eic.h_show_a3
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, any: [{op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: true}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}]}
          then: eic.line2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}]}
          then: eic.h_a6_min

  - id: eic.h_b7_0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 7: EIC Table credit for line 6, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_b7_1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 7: EIC Table credit for line 6, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_b7_2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 7: EIC Table credit for line 6, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_b7_3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 7: EIC Table credit for line 6, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.h_b7
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 7: Look up the amount on line 6 above in the EIC Table to find the credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    note: "Worksheet B lines 7 to 11 are not in this review's list. eic.credit needs them, so they are written as helpers."
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}
          then: eic.zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}]}
          then: eic.zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b7_0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b7_1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b7_2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b7_3

  - id: eic.h_b10_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B: smaller of line 10 (EIC Table credit for line 8, the same lookup as Worksheet A line 5) and line 7"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.h_b7]}

  - id: eic.h_b11
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 11: This is your earned income credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, any: [{op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.wsb_6]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}]}
          then: eic.h_b7
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ne: [eic.line3, eic.wsb_6]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}]}
          then: eic.h_b10_min

  - id: eic.h_figured
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit from the worksheet that applies (Worksheet A line 6 or Worksheet B line 11)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    refuses: [sa.excluded_income, scope.other_income, scope.schedule1, scope.other_line16]
    note: "These refusals stand for Step 1 questions 3 and 4 (Form 2555, nonresident aliens), Step 2 questions 3 and 4 (Form 4797, Schedule E, rental of personal property, Form 8814, passive activities) and Step 5 question 1 (clergy and church employees). They are placed here so they apply only where the credit is otherwise reached."
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_used, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.line6
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_used, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_b11

  - id: eic.h_7a_pos
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 1040 line 7a (if a loss, enter -0-)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f1040.line7a, take: eic.zero}

  - id: eic.h_inv
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 1: Investment income (lines 2a + 2b + 3b + 7a)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f1040.line2a, f1040.line2b, f1040.line3b, eic.h_7a_pos]}

  - id: eic.h_inv_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 2: Your investment income is not more than $11,950"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, le: [eic.h_inv, {param: eic.investment_limit}]}
    note: "Above the limit the filer is sent to the Form 4797 rules, and Form 4797 is out of scope (scope.schedule1). The STOP ('you can't take the credit') is applied."

  - id: eic.h_pass1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 1: Form 1040 line 11b is less than the limit for your children with valid SSNs and filing status"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_ssn_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 2: You, and your spouse if filing jointly, have an SSN valid for EIC purposes"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_reach3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 and 2 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_pass1, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_msh
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Are you a married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "hoh"}]}, {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_step3_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 (with a qualifying child) leads to Step 5"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_msh, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_age_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of you (and your spouse if filing jointly) born after December 31, 1960, and before January 2, 2001"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [person.born_before_2001, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [person.born_after_1960, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_step4_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4 (without a qualifying child), questions 1 to 5, leads to Step 5"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_msh, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, any: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}]}
    note: "Question 6 (can be claimed as a dependent) and the Pub. 596 referral for a death in 2025 are applied as refusals on the no-child credit branches (eic.h_cr4_joint, eic.h_cr4_other)."

  - id: eic.h_path_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 or Step 4, whichever applies, leads to Step 5"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step3_ok, {const: true}]}]}
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step4_ok, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_reach5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 to 4 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_path_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_earned_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 3 (Worksheet A filers) or Worksheet B line 4b and line 5: earned income is within the limit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_used, {const: false}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}]}
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_used, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_in_range, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can take the earned income credit (no STOP in Steps 1 to 5 or Worksheet B Part 4)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_earned_ok, {const: true}]}
    note: "The choice not to claim the credit (line 27c) has no input in this interface and is not modeled. A zero credit on Worksheet A line 2 or Worksheet B line 7 gives a zero credit through eic.credit."

  - id: eic.h_cr4_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Credit, filer without a qualifying child, joint return (Step 4, question 2: see Pub. 596 if your spouse died in 2025)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.h_figured}
    refuses: [eic.died_2025]

  - id: eic.h_cr4_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Credit, filer without a qualifying child, not a joint return (Step 4, questions 2 and 6)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.h_figured}
    refuses: [eic.died_2025, sa.dependent]
    note: "Step 4 question 6 (can you be claimed as a dependent) has only the screening input sa.dependent, so a Yes refuses rather than giving zero."

  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Your earned income credit (enter on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 27a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_figured
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_cr4_joint
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_cr4_other

  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 27c (instructed by Step 1 q2, Step 3 q6, Step 4 q3 or q5, Worksheet A line 2, or Worksheet B line 4b, line 5 or line 7)"
    type: Bool
    note: "Step 5 question 3 (No) and Step 2 STOPs do not instruct checking line 27c, so they are excluded here."
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_pass1, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: false}]}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_msh, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_msh, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, ge: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_msh, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, ge: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_used, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_used, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b7, {const: 0}]}

  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section that discusses the special rule for separated spouses (Step 3, question 6, No)"
    type: Bool
    note: "The flowchart sends every 'No' at Step 3 question 6 to this box. The Special rule for separated spouses limits it to married filers not filing jointly who lived apart for the last 6 months or are legally separated. That narrower reading is applied (married MFS or HOH, not joint)."
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_msh, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, any: [{op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
```
